leaves.leaf: Construction and completeness axioms of the real numbers
leaves.scope: Axiomatic and constructive foundations of the reals: Dedekind cuts, Cauchy-sequence constructions, the least-upper-bound and Archimedean properties, and equivalent forms of the completeness axiom.
queries: Cauchy sequences equivalence classes construction reals
least upper bound property Archimedean ordered field
nested interval property completeness axiom equivalent

leaves.leaf: Real sequences, limits and limit superior/inferior
leaves.scope: Convergence of real sequences, including the monotone convergence theorem, Bolzano–Weierstrass, the Cauchy criterion, limsup/liminf, subsequential limits and the Stolz–Cesàro theorem.
queries: Bolzano Weierstrass theorem bounded sequence subsequence
limit superior limit inferior sequence definition
monotone convergence theorem real sequences Cauchy criterion

leaves.leaf: Convergence tests for infinite series
leaves.scope: Tests for whether numerical series converge: comparison, ratio, root, integral, Raabe, Kummer, Gauss, Bertrand, Cauchy condensation, alternating series, and the Dirichlet and Abel tests.
queries: Raabe test Gauss test series convergence
Dirichlet test Abel test alternating series
Kummer test Bertrand test convergence criterion

leaves.leaf: Conditional convergence, rearrangements and products of series
leaves.scope: Absolute versus conditional convergence, the Riemann rearrangement theorem, the Lévy–Steinitz theorem, Cauchy products, Mertens' theorem and double series.
queries: Riemann series theorem rearrangement conditionally convergent
double series iterated sums absolute convergence

leaves.leaf: Summation of divergent series and Tauberian theorems
leaves.scope: Cesàro, Abel, Borel, Euler, Lambert and Ramanujan summation methods, regularity via the Silverman–Toeplitz theorem, and the Tauberian theorems of Tauber, Hardy–Littlewood, Karamata and Wiener.
queries: Cesaro summation Abel summation divergent series

leaves.leaf: Classical series, infinite products and closed-form constants
leaves.scope: Well-known series and products that evaluate constants, such as the Basel problem, the Leibniz and Machin formulas for pi, the Wallis and Viète products, the alternating harmonic series and Apéry's constant.
queries: Basel problem Euler sum reciprocal squares

leaves.leaf: Power series and real-analytic functions
leaves.scope: Radius and interval of convergence, the Cauchy–Hadamard formula, Abel's theorem on boundary behaviour, term-by-term differentiation, real-analytic functions and quasi-analytic classes (Denjoy–Carleman).
queries: Cauchy Hadamard formula radius of convergence

leaves.leaf: Topology of the real line and metric spaces
leaves.scope: Open, closed and compact sets in the reals and in metric spaces, covering Heine–Borel, sequential compactness, connectedness, completeness, the Baire category theorem and the Banach fixed-point theorem.
queries: Heine Borel theorem compact closed bounded
Baire category theorem complete metric space
Banach fixed point contraction mapping theorem
totally bounded complete metric space compactness

leaves.leaf: Limits and continuity of real functions
leaves.scope: Epsilon-delta limits, one-sided limits, the intermediate and extreme value theorems, uniform continuity, the Heine–Cantor theorem, Lipschitz and Hölder continuity, and the classification of discontinuities.
queries: intermediate value theorem extreme value theorem proof
classification of discontinuities removable jump essential
Lipschitz continuity Holder condition modulus of continuity

leaves.leaf: Pathological functions and sets in analysis
leaves.scope: Standard counterexamples, including the Weierstrass and Takagi nowhere-differentiable functions, the Cantor function, the Thomae and Dirichlet functions, Volterra's function, the Conway base 13 function, and the Cantor and Smith–Volterra–Cantor sets.
queries: Volterra function Smith Volterra Cantor set
Cantor function devil's staircase Takagi blancmange

leaves.leaf: Mean value theorems and properties of derivatives
leaves.scope: Rolle's theorem, the Lagrange and Cauchy mean value theorems, Darboux's theorem on the intermediate value property of derivatives, L'Hôpital's rule and related results on derivatives.
queries: Rolle theorem mean value theorem proof
Darboux theorem derivative intermediate value property
L'Hopital rule Bernoulli indeterminate forms history

leaves.leaf: Taylor's theorem, remainder forms and smooth functions
leaves.scope: Taylor polynomials and remainder forms (Lagrange, Cauchy, integral, Peano, Schlömilch), Maclaurin series, smooth non-analytic functions, bump functions and Borel's lemma.
queries: Taylor theorem Lagrange remainder Cauchy form

leaves.leaf: Riemann, Darboux and Riemann–Stieltjes integration
leaves.scope: Integrals defined by partitions and tagged sums, upper and lower Darboux sums, Lebesgue's criterion for Riemann integrability, the Riemann–Stieltjes integral, and the fundamental theorem of calculus.
queries: Lebesgue criterion Riemann integrability measure zero
Riemann Stieltjes integral integrator bounded variation
fundamental theorem of calculus proof Riemann

leaves.leaf: Improper integrals and famous definite integrals
leaves.scope: Convergence of improper integrals and well-known evaluations such as the Gaussian, Dirichlet, Fresnel, Frullani, Borwein and Ahmed integrals.
queries: Dirichlet integral sin x over x

leaves.leaf: Techniques of integration
leaves.scope: Methods for finding antiderivatives: substitution, integration by parts (including the tabular method), partial fractions, trigonometric and hyperbolic substitution, the Weierstrass and Euler substitutions, reduction formulas, and differentiation under the integral sign.
queries: Euler substitution integrals square root quadratic
Leibniz integral rule differentiation under integral sign
reduction formula integration by parts tabular

leaves.leaf: Nonelementary antiderivatives and symbolic integration
leaves.scope: Liouville's theorem on elementary antiderivatives, the Risch algorithm, differential algebra, and named nonelementary integrals such as the error function, logarithmic integral, sine integral and elliptic integrals.
queries: Liouville theorem differential algebra elementary antiderivative
nonelementary integral error function logarithmic integral
elliptic integral first second kind complete

leaves.leaf: Geometric applications of integration
leaves.scope: Arc length, surface area and volumes of revolution (disk, washer and shell methods), Pappus's centroid theorems, Cavalieri's principle, and classic curves and solids such as the cycloid, catenary and Gabriel's horn.
queries: Pappus centroid theorem volume surface area
shell method washer method volume revolution

leaves.leaf: Uniform convergence of sequences and series of functions
leaves.scope: Pointwise versus uniform convergence, the Weierstrass M-test, Dini's theorem, swapping limits with integrals and derivatives, equicontinuity and the Arzelà–Ascoli theorem.
queries: Dini theorem monotone uniform convergence compact
uniform convergence interchange limit derivative integral

leaves.leaf: Polynomial approximation theorems
leaves.scope: The Weierstrass approximation theorem, the Stone–Weierstrass theorem, Bernstein polynomials, the Müntz–Szász theorem, Chebyshev equioscillation, and the Jackson and Bernstein theorems on best approximation.
queries: Stone Weierstrass theorem algebra separates points

leaves.leaf: Lebesgue measure and measurable sets
leaves.scope: Lebesgue outer measure, Carathéodory measurability, Borel versus Lebesgue sets, Vitali non-measurable sets, the Lebesgue density theorem, the Steinhaus theorem and related set constructions.
queries: Vitali set non-measurable axiom of choice

leaves.leaf: Abstract measure theory
leaves.scope: Sigma-algebras, measure spaces, the Carathéodory extension theorem, the Dynkin π–λ theorem, signed measures with Hahn and Jordan decompositions, and the Radon–Nikodym and Lebesgue decomposition theorems.
queries: Radon Nikodym theorem derivative absolutely continuous measure

leaves.leaf: Lebesgue integral and its limit theorems
leaves.scope: Building the Lebesgue integral from simple functions, the monotone convergence theorem, Fatou's lemma, dominated convergence, the Vitali convergence theorem, and Fubini–Tonelli for product measures.

leaves.leaf: Lp spaces
leaves.scope: Definitions and properties of Lp and lp spaces: the Hölder and Minkowski inequalities, Riesz–Fischer completeness, duality and conjugate exponents, the essential supremum, inclusions between spaces, and density of continuous functions.

leaves.leaf: Bounded variation, absolute continuity and differentiation theorems
leaves.scope: Functions of bounded variation, the Jordan decomposition, absolutely continuous functions, Lebesgue's differentiation theorem, the Vitali covering lemma, Dini derivatives, Rademacher's theorem, and the fundamental theorem of calculus for Lebesgue integrals.
queries: absolutely continuous function Lebesgue fundamental theorem
Lebesgue differentiation theorem Vitali covering lemma
Dini derivatives Denjoy Young Saks theorem

leaves.leaf: Classical inequalities of analysis
leaves.scope: Elementary and integral inequalities and their sharp constants: AM–GM, Cauchy–Schwarz, Jensen, Bernoulli, Young, Chebyshev's sum inequality, the rearrangement inequality, and the Hardy, Carleman and Hilbert inequalities.

leaves.leaf: Hausdorff measure and fractal dimension
leaves.scope: Hausdorff measure and dimension, box-counting (Minkowski) dimension, self-similar sets, and the dimensions of standard fractals such as the Cantor set, the Koch curve and the Sierpiński triangle.
queries: Hausdorff dimension Cantor set log 2 log 3

leaves.leaf: Non-absolute and generalized integrals
leaves.scope: Integrals that go beyond Lebesgue's, such as the Henstock–Kurzweil gauge integral, the Denjoy, Perron, McShane and Khinchin integrals, and the Daniell integral.

leaves.leaf: Multivariable differential calculus
leaves.scope: Partial and directional derivatives, total (Fréchet) differentiability, Schwarz–Clairaut symmetry of second derivatives, Jacobian and Hessian matrices, the multivariable chain rule, and the inverse and implicit function theorems.
queries: Schwarz theorem symmetry second derivatives Clairaut

leaves.leaf: Multiple integrals and change of variables
leaves.scope: Double and triple integrals, Fubini's theorem for iterated Riemann integrals, the Jacobian change-of-variables formula, polar, cylindrical and spherical coordinates, and volumes of n-balls.
queries: change of variables multiple integral Jacobian determinant
spherical coordinates volume element triple integral
volume of n-ball formula gamma function
Fubini theorem iterated integral order counterexample

leaves.leaf: Vector calculus integral theorems and differential forms
leaves.scope: Line and surface integrals, Green's theorem, the Kelvin–Stokes and divergence (Gauss–Ostrogradsky) theorems, vector identities, the exterior derivative, the Poincaré lemma and the generalized Stokes theorem.
queries: generalized Stokes theorem differential forms exterior derivative

leaves.leaf: Extrema and Lagrange multipliers
leaves.scope: Critical points, the first and second derivative tests, classification by the Hessian, saddle points, Lagrange multipliers, the bordered Hessian, and constrained extrema in several variables.
queries: second partial derivative test Hessian determinant

leaves.leaf: Calculus of variations
leaves.scope: Extrema of functionals: the Euler–Lagrange equation, the Beltrami identity, the brachistochrone and isoperimetric problems, the Legendre and Jacobi conditions, the Weierstrass E-function, and direct methods.
queries: Legendre condition Jacobi condition second variation

leaves.leaf: Gamma and beta functions and Stirling's formula
leaves.scope: Euler's gamma and beta integrals, the Bohr–Mollerup theorem, the reflection and duplication formulas, Stirling's approximation, the digamma function and the Euler–Mascheroni constant.
queries: Bohr Mollerup theorem gamma function log-convex

leaves.leaf: Asymptotic expansions and Euler–Maclaurin summation
leaves.scope: Asymptotic notation and series, Laplace's method, stationary phase, steepest descent, Watson's lemma, the Euler–Maclaurin formula, Bernoulli numbers and Abel's summation formula.
queries: Euler Maclaurin formula Bernoulli numbers remainder

leaves.leaf: Convergence of Fourier series and integrals
leaves.scope: Pointwise, uniform and mean-square convergence of Fourier series, the Dirichlet and Fejér kernels, the Gibbs phenomenon, the Riemann–Lebesgue lemma, Carleson's theorem, Kolmogorov's divergence example, Parseval/Plancherel and Poisson summation.

leaves.leaf: Existence and uniqueness theorems for ordinary differential equations
leaves.scope: The Picard–Lindelöf and Peano existence theorems, Picard iteration, Grönwall's inequality, the Osgood uniqueness criterion, Carathéodory solutions, and continuation of solutions.

leaves.leaf: Fractional calculus
leaves.scope: Derivatives and integrals of non-integer order: the Riemann–Liouville, Caputo, Grünwald–Letnikov and Weyl definitions, the Cauchy formula for repeated integration, and the Mittag-Leffler function.

leaves.leaf: Infinitesimals and nonstandard analysis
leaves.scope: Rigorous approaches to infinitesimals: Robinson's nonstandard analysis, the hyperreal numbers, the transfer principle and standard part, Keisler's calculus textbook, Nelson's internal set theory, and smooth infinitesimal analysis.
queries: hyperreal numbers transfer principle standard part

leaves.leaf: Origins of calculus and its notation
leaves.scope: Precursors (Archimedes, Fermat, Cavalieri, Barrow), Newton's fluxions and Leibniz's differentials, their priority dispute, Berkeley's critique, and where the derivative and integral notations came from.
queries: Newton Leibniz calculus priority controversy Royal Society
Leibniz notation integral sign Nova Methodus
Berkeley The Analyst ghosts of departed quantities

leaves.leaf: Nineteenth-century rigorization of analysis
leaves.scope: The arithmetization of analysis by Bolzano, Cauchy, Abel, Dirichlet, Riemann, Weierstrass, Heine, Dedekind and Cantor, including key publications such as Cauchy's Cours d'analyse and the arrival of epsilon-delta definitions.

leaves.leaf: Convex functions and convexity on the real line
leaves.scope: Properties of convex, log-convex, quasi-convex and midpoint-convex functions: one-sided derivatives, continuity and differentiability almost everywhere, Alexandrov's theorem, convex conjugates and the Legendre–Fenchel transform.
queries: convex function one-sided derivatives continuity interior
midpoint convex function Sierpinski measurable continuous
Alexandrov theorem convex function second derivative

leaves.leaf: Functional equations in real analysis
leaves.scope: Classical functional equations over the reals and what their solutions look like under regularity conditions, including Cauchy's additive equation, Hamel-basis pathologies, Jensen, Pexider and d'Alembert equations, and Hyers–Ulam stability.
queries: Cauchy functional equation Hamel basis solutions
Jensen functional equation d'Alembert cosine equation
Pexider equation additive multiplicative logarithmic functional equations

leaves.leaf: Numerical integration and quadrature rules
leaves.scope: Approximate integration rules and their error terms, including trapezoidal, midpoint and Simpson's rules, Newton–Cotes formulas, Gaussian, Gauss–Kronrod and Clenshaw–Curtis quadrature, and Romberg extrapolation.
queries: Simpson's rule error bound fourth derivative
Newton Cotes formulas trapezoidal rule error term
Romberg integration Richardson extrapolation Gauss Kronrod

leaves.leaf: Laplace, Mellin and other integral transforms
leaves.scope: Definitions, operational properties, inversion formulas and named theorems for the Laplace, Mellin, Hankel, Hilbert and related integral transforms (Fourier convergence theory excluded).

Bromwich integral inverse Laplace transform Post inversion
Mellin transform fundamental strip Ramanujan master theorem

leaves.leaf: Distributions and generalized functions
leaves.scope: Schwartz's theory of distributions, covering test functions, the Dirac delta, tempered distributions and the Schwartz space, principal values, weak derivatives and the Sobolev spaces built on them.

tempered distributions Fourier transform Schwartz space
Sokhotski Plemelj theorem principal value distribution
weak derivative Sobolev space embedding theorem

leaves.leaf: Baire category and descriptive set theory of the reals
leaves.scope: The Baire category theorem and its uses in analysis, meagre and residual sets, Baire classes of functions, the Borel hierarchy, analytic (Suslin) sets and the Banach–Mazur game.
queries: Baire category theorem meagre set applications
Baire class functions pointwise limits continuous
Banach Mazur game comeagre residual set

leaves.leaf: Calculus of finite differences and umbral calculus
leaves.scope: Discrete counterparts of differentiation and integration: forward, backward and central difference operators, Newton's forward-difference series, falling factorials and Stirling numbers, indefinite sums, summation by parts, Nörlund–Rice integrals and umbral calculus.
queries: finite difference operator forward difference Newton series
falling factorial Stirling numbers indefinite sum
umbral calculus Sheffer sequence shift operator
Norlund Rice integral summation by parts discrete

leaves.leaf: Elementary transcendental functions and their identities
leaves.scope: Definitions, principal branches, identities and history of the exponential, logarithmic, trigonometric, inverse trigonometric and hyperbolic functions, plus related functions such as the Gudermannian and Lambert W.
queries: hyperbolic functions inverse identities Gudermannian function
history of logarithms Napier Briggs tables
inverse trigonometric functions principal values identities
